comparisons.name: current-coherent-full
comparisons.method: Fresh shared source nomination, focused research and final publication over retained dated inputs.
comparisons.outcome: Substantive independent agenda/findings improved. Six focused investigations completed; two lost first synthesis at an internal phase cutoff with original time unused. Acquired sources survived. Public output still copied too many financial figures.

comparisons.name: current-coherent-completion-retry
comparisons.method: Retained actual acquisitions, fresh completion of the two interrupted subjects, then composition/review on the shared remaining-clock design.
comparisons.outcome: Both subjects produced retained findings and final publication completed; overview improved but expanded stories still transcribed financial line items.

comparisons.name: current-coherent-editor-contract
comparisons.method: Fresh writer/review with explicit public-field purposes and historical knowledge timing.
comparisons.outcome: Microsoft and Vertiv details became more selective, but the overview was still a long inventory and other stories still repeated financial figures. Process/capture language persisted. Rejected personally despite model reviewer revision/acceptance.

important_limits: Historical fixtures were dated04:06UTC, while shared acquisition read a subsequently populated current corpus. Timing/availability needs careful distinction; these are not clean historical backtests. No production feed was written from these outputs.
All compared core research/writing/review used the full Pro model. These failures do not establish that cheaper production models caused them.
Operational tests establish budget/clock/provenance behavior only.

prepared_fresh_comparison.method: Same completed-run source corpus and numerical observation dates. Fresh shared composition/review only, isolated local state, no production writes and no new acquisition. Compare all actual public fields; no curated excerpt or topic/number quota.

continuation_spending.quotation: New future attempts quote the published maximum rate over their full bounded slot/request window; previous maxima remain untouched.

local_release_hold: No coherent-design image build or deployment before personally accepted complete output. Existing approved production recovery remains live.
